data: Which line has the highest value for alpha = 0.4?

The question asks which line has the highest value for alpha = 0.4. From the caption, we know that the figure shows retrieval results of the tf.idf weighted link translations combined with different concept models. The lines in the graph represent these different models. 

Looking at the graph, there are four lines: one solid line, one dashed line, one dotted line, and one dash-dotted line. The legend indicates what each line represents. At alpha = 0.4, the solid line appears to have the highest value among all the lines. Therefore, the line corresponding to the model 'α lda + (1 - α) links' has the highest value for alpha = 0.4.
